typeNotes.scroll: Scrolls last 30 min and stack with elixirs (separate buff aura). Each pick is the highest rank usable at 19 — the next rank up is level-gated above the cap.
typeNotes.food: The interchangeable +6 Stamina / +6 Spirit Well Fed foods all give the same buff — pick whichever mats you can get.

consumables.name: Healing Potion
consumables.effect: Instant health restore; shares the potion cooldown. Keep the highest rank usable at level 19 on cooldown.
consumables.notes: Healing Potion (item 929, Requires Level 12) is the highest healing potion usable at 19; Greater Healing Potion requires level 21.

consumables.name: Lesser Mana Potion
consumables.effect: Instant mana restore; shares the potion cooldown. Mana-using classes keep one on cooldown.
consumables.notes: For mana-using classes. Lesser Mana Potion (item 3385, Requires Level 14) is the highest mana potion usable at 19; Mana Potion requires level 22.

consumables.name: Swiftness Potion
consumables.effect: Increases run speed by 50% for 15 sec; shares the potion cooldown. Flag-running and gap-closing tool in WSG.
consumables.notes: Item 2459, Requires Level 5. Shares the standard potion cooldown (trade-off vs a Healing Potion). Note: Free Action Potion (stun/root immunity) is NOT usable at 19 — it requires level 20.

consumables.name: Rage Potion
consumables.effect: Instantly generates 20–40 rage; shares the potion cooldown. Opener burst for a rage-starved start.
consumables.notes: Item 5631, Requires Level 4. Useful to rage users (warrior, and druid in bear form). Shares the standard potion cooldown.

consumables.name: Heavy Runecloth Bandage
consumables.effect: BiS bandage at 19: channeled First Aid heal for 2000 over 8 sec — does NOT share the potion cooldown, so pair it with a healing potion. Breaks on damage taken and applies the 60s Recently Bandaged debuff.
consumables.notes: Item 14530, heals 2000 over 8 sec; requires First Aid 225 to USE (no character-level requirement). Reachable at 19 because Expert First Aid — Under Wraps has NO character-level gate (only First Aid 125), so a 19 twink can push First Aid to the 225 cap and use it. Mageweave (800), Heavy Mageweave (1104), and Runecloth (1360) fill the gap while leveling First Aid.

consumables.name: Rumsey Rum Black Label
consumables.effect: Persistent Well Fed-style buff: +15 Stamina for 15 min (does NOT share the potion cooldown). Pre-buff before a match for ~150 extra HP.
consumables.notes: Item 21151, no character-level requirement; grants +15 Stamina for 15 min (also applies mild drunkenness). Persists through the potion cooldown; strong 19 pre-buff. Obtained via AH/vendor.

consumables.name: Elixir of Lesser Agility
consumables.effect: +8 Agility for 1 hour. Persistent buff; does NOT share the potion cooldown.
consumables.notes: Item 3390, Requires Level 18. Best agility elixir usable at 19 — its +8 Agility strictly replaces Elixir of Minor Agility's +4, and Elixir of Agility requires level 40. In Classic Era elixirs stack freely (no battle/guardian limit) and stack with the matching scroll (different buff aura), so run this alongside Scroll of Agility.

consumables.name: Elixir of Lion's Strength
consumables.effect: +4 Strength for 1 hour. Persistent buff; does NOT share the potion cooldown.
consumables.notes: Item 2454, no character-level requirement. Stacks with Scroll of Strength and other elixirs in Classic Era.

consumables.name: Elixir of Defense
consumables.effect: +150 armor for 1 hour. Persistent buff; does NOT share the potion cooldown.
consumables.notes: Item 3389, Requires Level 16. Highest flat-armor elixir usable at 19; stacks with Scroll of Protection II.

consumables.name: Elixir of Minor Fortitude
consumables.effect: +27 maximum health for 1 hour. Persistent buff; does NOT share the potion cooldown.
consumables.notes: Item 2458, Requires Level 2. Small but cheap HP bump; stacks with the other elixirs.

consumables.name: Strong Troll's Blood Potion
consumables.effect: Regenerate 6 health every 5 sec for 1 hour. Persistent buff; does NOT share the combat potion cooldown.
consumables.notes: Item 3388, Requires Level 15. Technically a potion, but its 1-hour regen buff behaves like an elixir — it applies its own aura, does not trigger the shared combat potion cooldown, and stacks with your other elixirs and scrolls. Mighty Troll's Blood (regen 12) requires level 26, so Strong is the best Troll's Blood usable at 19.

consumables.name: Heavy Sharpening Stone
consumables.effect: +4 damage to an edged weapon (sword/dagger/axe/polearm) for 30 min. Temporary weapon enhancement.
consumables.notes: Item 2871, Requires Level 15. Best sharpening stone usable at 19 — Solid Sharpening Stone requires level 35.

consumables.name: Heavy Weightstone
consumables.effect: +4 damage to a blunt weapon (mace/staff) for 30 min. Temporary weapon enhancement.
consumables.notes: Item 3241, Requires Level 15. Blunt-weapon counterpart to the Heavy Sharpening Stone; Solid Weightstone requires level 35.

consumables.name: Minor Wizard Oil
consumables.effect: +8 spell damage while applied to the weapon, for 30 min. For spell-damage casters.
consumables.notes: Item 20744, Requires Level 5. Spell-damage weapon enhancement (ZG-era, patch 1.11). Minor Mana Oil is NOT usable at 19 — it requires level 20.

consumables.name: Thistle Tea
consumables.effect: Instantly restores 100 energy on its own 5-minute cooldown (does NOT share the standard potion cooldown). Rogue burst-energy tool for a flag grab or kill.
consumables.notes: Item 7676, Rogue-only, Requires Level 5; restores 100 energy, 5-min cooldown. Rogues can carry these at 19 (poisons unlock at level 20, so a 19 rogue uses no weapon poisons).

consumables.name: Heavy Dynamite
consumables.effect: Thrown AoE fire damage (Engineering) — burst, finisher, and tag utility.
consumables.notes: Item 4378, inflicts 128–172 Fire damage in a 5-yard radius on a 1-minute cooldown; requires Engineering 125 to craft, no character-level requirement.

consumables.name: Big Bronze Bomb
consumables.effect: Thrown AoE that damages and stuns everything in the blast (Engineering) — a 2-second stun to peel, set up a kill, or lock down a flag carrier.
consumables.notes: Item 4380, inflicts 85–115 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 5-yard radius for 2 sec (any damage breaks the stun; unreliable vs level 44+). Requires Engineering 140 to craft, no character-level requirement — any 19 engineer can carry it (Journeyman caps at 150).

consumables.name: Explosive Sheep
consumables.effect: Summons a sheep that charges the nearest enemy and detonates for AoE fire damage (Engineering) — a deployable burst/tag tool that soaks a stealth opener or zones a chokepoint.
consumables.notes: Item 4384, summons an Explosive Sheep that charges a nearby enemy and explodes for 135–165 damage; lasts 3 min or until it detonates, 1-minute cooldown. Requires Engineering 150 to craft, no character-level requirement — sits right at the 19 Journeyman skill cap of 150.

consumables.name: Portable Bronze Mortar
consumables.effect: Thrown AoE that damages and incapacitates everything in the blast (Engineering) — gnome-only at 19: a second stun-bomb only Gnome engineers can craft in-bracket.
consumables.notes: Item 4403, inflicts 100 Fire damage and incapacitates targets in a 5-yard radius for 2 sec (any damage breaks it; unreliable vs level 44+). Requires Engineering 165 to craft (schematic is a world drop) — at level 19 non-gnomes cap at 150 (Expert 151+ needs level 20), but the Gnome +15 Engineering Specialization racial reaches 165, so only Gnome engineers can make this in the bracket.
